newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 2,100 Slaughter steers and 200 heifers; 80,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 26,000 formulated and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 66.00.
Wk to Date - 80,200 Week Ago - 106,100 Year Ago - 87,000
